scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm infra:up && pnpm build && pnpm migrate && pnpm pubsub:setup
scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm pubsub:setup && pnpm build && pnpm -r --parallel --if-present dev
scripts.infra:errors: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs postgres | grep -A2 ERROR || echo 'No errors in Postgres logs.'
scripts.ledger:migrate: pnpm --filter ledger-service build && pnpm --filter ledger-service migration:run
scripts.invoice:migrate: pnpm --filter invoice-service build && pnpm --filter invoice-service migration:run
scripts.notification:migrate: pnpm --filter notification-service build && pnpm --filter notification-service migration:run
scripts.bank: pnpm --filter bank-simulator build && pnpm --filter bank-simulator start
scripts.payment:migrate: pnpm --filter payment-service build && pnpm --filter payment-service migration:run
